# Vazirmatn

The bundled `src/app/fonts/vazirmatn-variable.woff2` is the unmodified variable webfont from
Vazirmatn release `v33.003`, by Saber Rastikerdar and the contributors listed in AUTHORS.txt.

- Source: https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/tree/v33.003
- File: `fonts/webfonts/Vazirmatn[wght].woff2`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in OFL.txt.
- SHA-256: `4e3fa217d38fdafc1fea4414ceb58ca5e662cf0ab5fa735a8c8c20e8b42cad92`

The app serves this font locally with `next/font/local`. The Persian document language selects
it as the interface font. Retain the license and author notices when distributing the font.
